quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec results briefing Q&A: Briefing summary and Q&A, year ended March 2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing (year ended March 2026), Advanced Materials Operations by product: semiconductor-related devices JPY 217 hundred million (down 3.9%), with orders and deliveries of equipment for HBM manufacturing recovering in the second half; semiconductor-related adhesive tapes JPY 448 hundred million (up 13.2%) on strong AI-related demand; the division's overseas sales ratio was 74.3%. At consolidated subsidiaries, Advanced Materials profit rose on higher semiconductor tape volumes despite fewer HBM-manufacturing equipment units sold in Korea. US subsidiary Mactac America's sales were JPY 863 hundred million (down 2%) and its operating loss widened to JPY 39 hundred million, weighed by worse process yields and JPY 44 hundred million of goodwill amortization; management said it has sent a team of Japanese engineers to improve yields and expects results to turn around soon, and that it has no specific M&A candidate at present.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor-related devices JPY 217 hundred million (-3.9%); semiconductor-related adhesive tapes JPY 448 hundred million (+13.2%); Mactac America operating loss JPY 39 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec results briefing Q&A: Briefing summary and Q&A, year ended March 2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing, plan for the year ending March 2027: net sales JPY 3,420 hundred million and operating income JPY 275 hundred million; the parent's operating profit bridge assumes JPY 48 hundred million from higher volume and JPY 67 hundred million from price revisions against JPY 47 hundred million of higher raw material and fuel prices caused by Middle East tensions and JPY 42 hundred million of higher fixed costs. Advanced Materials Operations sales are planned at JPY 1,014 hundred million (up 9.3%): management expects semiconductor-related adhesive tape volumes to keep rising on strong AI-related demand and semiconductor-related devices to keep growing as HBM-manufacturing orders have recovered since the prior second half. Capex is planned at JPY 150 hundred million, including a new system for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes and a new research building in the Kansai region; depreciation JPY 138 hundred million; R&D up JPY 20 hundred million to JPY 133 hundred million, focused on establishing mass production of EUV lithography pellicles and new semiconductor adhesive tapes and materials; goodwill amortization falls to JPY 41 hundred million as Mactac America's amortization ends in November 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Plan: net sales JPY 3,420 hundred million; operating income JPY 275 hundred million; Advanced Materials sales JPY 1,014 hundred million; capex JPY 150 hundred million; R&D JPY 133 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec results briefing Q&A: Briefing summary and Q&A, year ended March 2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): semiconductor-related adhesive tape sales have risen about 60% over the last few years, far above the growth in semiconductor wafer shipment area compiled by the industry association, so the company believes it has kept its market share in a narrow market with long-standing competitors. By region, Taiwan has grown the most, China's weight has increased considerably as Lintec tapes are adopted there, followed by Korea and ASEAN. Equipment for semiconductor-related adhesive tapes invested two years ago received qualification last year and is ready to contribute this year. The plan includes JPY 30 hundred million a year of higher raw material and fuel costs from the Middle East situation, for which price revisions are being considered; Printing and Information Materials, Advanced Materials and Converted Products are expected to be most affected. Procurement, mainly of solvents, has been affected - at first one month ahead could not be secured, but visibility has improved somewhat - and the company is doing its utmost to keep supply stable but says cost increases are unavoidable.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor-related adhesive tape sales up about 60% over the last few years; Middle East cost impact JPY 30 hundred million a year

quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec results briefing Q&A: Briefing summary and Q&A, year ended March 2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: EUV pellicle (results briefing Q&A): management said the pellicle budget is JPY 50 hundred million; about JPY 14 hundred million was invested in mass-production capacity last fiscal year and more than JPY 20 hundred million in total so far including R&D, with about JPY 30 hundred million planned this fiscal year. It expects to establish its mass-production system around the first half, and samples have already been provided, with sample frequency rising as the system is completed.
quarterly_data.figure: Pellicle budget JPY 50 hundred million; about JPY 30 hundred million planned this fiscal year; mass-production system around H1

quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec results briefing Q&A: Briefing summary and Q&A, year ended March 2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Multilayer ceramic capacitor-related tape (results briefing): sales were JPY 239 hundred million in the year ended March 2026 (up 13.7%) on strong high-end demand for data centers and smartphones. Management said utilization of its MLCC-related tape capacity is currently about 8 tenths, leaving room; it expects higher demand from smartphones, AI servers and automotive uses and will make full use of the new equipment brought up over the past few years, and says it faces long-standing competition from film makers while strengthening quality, volume and supply to raise market share.
quarterly_data.figure: MLCC-related tape sales JPY 239 hundred million (+13.7%); capacity utilization about 8 tenths
